turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files describing perovskite solar cells as
complete devices — `substrate` (glass + transparent electrode), `etl`
(electron-transport layer stack), `htl` (hole-transport layer stack),
`backcontact` (metal / carbon back electrode), `deposition` (absorber
deposition procedure; `>>` separates steps). Every candidate below uses the
same MAPbI3 absorber in the same p-i-n (inverted) architecture; they differ
only in the remaining columns. Each row is a device CONFIGURATION whose
efficiency is the median over at least 3 independently fabricated cells, so
it is a reproducible recipe rather than a single champion cell:
  - b3_pvk_stack_pin_train.csv: 300 configurations with the measured power
    conversion efficiency (%).
  - b3_pvk_stack_pin_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE configurations whose power
    conversion efficiency (%) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same device columns.

Using the training data, select the 5 candidates with the HIGHEST power
conversion efficiency (%).

Reason from the device physics — band alignment and selectivity of the
transport layers, interface recombination, contact chemistry and the film
quality the process is likely to give — then end your answer with an
explicit ranked list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902,
c903, c904, c905".
turns.answer_text:
The strongest candidates combine the motifs that repeatedly give high PCE in training: fullerene ETLs with a thin hole-blocking/interfacial layer (BCP/Bphen/PEI/C60), high-quality p-type contacts such as PTAA, NiMgLiO/NiO with plasmonic Au nanoparticles, and Cu/Ag rather than purely Al back contacts. Inverted MAPbI3 devices benefit most from: good electron selectivity at PCBM/C60 interfaces, suppressed interfacial recombination via BCP/Bphen/PEI/Zr-type interlayers, and p-contacts with deep HOMO/high hole mobility such as PTAA or doped NiO. Exotic single layers can help, but I weight proven stacks and close analogues of high-PCE training rows more heavily.

Top physics-motivated picks:
- **c038**: close to the 20% Au-np/NiO-c hole-contact motif, with PEI improving the PCBM electron contact.
- **c044**: PCBM-60/BCP + PTAA + Cu is a proven high-Voc/high-FF combination.
- **c030**: based on the high PCBM-60/Bphen + PTAA/PMMA motif; added nonfullerene ETL should aid electron extraction if cascaded properly.
- **c041**: FTO/PCBM/BCP with NiMgLiO-c resembles high-performing NiMgLiO inverted devices.
- **c088**: C60/BCP + PTAA + Cu is repeatedly excellent; doctor blading is scalable but still consistent with high-performing coated devices.

Final: c038, c044, c030, c041, c088
